Title: User submits the User Details form with all fields filled
Preconditions: Backend is running at http://localhost:8000 and Streamlit UI is running via "streamlit run ui/app.py"
Steps: 1. Open the app in a browser | 2. Select "User Details" in the sidebar | 3. Fill in Name, Email, Phone number, and Message | 4. Click "Submit"
Test Data: Name=Jane Doe, Email=jane.doe@example.com, Phone=555-123-4567, Message=Please contact me about benefits
Expected Result: Form clears (clear_on_submit), a success message "Thanks, Jane Doe! We've received your details." is shown, and POST /api/user returns 200 with {"status": "received", "name": "Jane Doe"}

Title: Submitted user details are received end-to-end by the backend API
Preconditions: Backend (uvicorn backend.main:app) and Streamlit UI are both running
Steps: 1. Navigate to the "User Details" page in the UI | 2. Submit the form with valid Name and Email | 3. Inspect the backend process/logs or add a temporary print to confirm the submission was appended to _user_submissions | 4. Call GET /health to confirm backend is still healthy
Expected Result: The backend receives the POST /api/user request, stores the submission, responds 200, and /health continues to return {"status": "ok"}

Title: User submits the form with only the required fields (Name and Email) and leaves Phone/Message blank
Steps: 1. Open "User Details" page | 2. Enter only Name and Email | 3. Leave Phone and Message empty | 4. Click "Submit"
Expected Result: Submission succeeds since phone and message are optional; success message displays and POST /api/user returns 200 with {"status": "received", "name": "Sam Lee"}

Title: Backend accepts a valid /api/user payload directly via API call
Steps: 1. Send POST /api/user with a JSON body containing name, email, phone, and message | 2. Inspect the HTTP response
Expected Result: Response status is 200 and body is {"status": "received", "name": "Jane Doe"}

Title: User submits the form without a Name or Email
Steps: 1. Open "User Details" page | 2. Leave Name and Email blank | 3. Optionally fill Phone/Message | 4. Click "Submit"
Expected Result: UI shows the error "Name and email are required." and no POST /api/user request is sent

Title: Backend rejects a direct /api/user API call missing the required email field
Steps: 1. Send POST /api/user with a JSON body missing the "email" key | 2. Inspect the HTTP response
Expected Result: Response status is 422 with a validation error detail indicating the "email" field is required

Title: UI shows a graceful fallback message when the backend is unreachable
Preconditions: Streamlit UI is running but the FastAPI backend is stopped
Steps: 1. Stop the backend process | 2. Open "User Details" page in the UI | 3. Fill in Name and Email | 4. Click "Submit"
Expected Result: UI catches the requests.RequestException and shows the warning "Thanks, Pat Rivera! Your details were captured locally (backend not reachable)."
